notes.title: Fall Words is OUT!
notes.notes:
🎊 Happy to announce that [b]Fall Words[/b] is finally out on Steam! 🎊

On this occasion, [b]30% discount[/b] for 10 days!

Please leave a review if you enjoy the game!

notes.title: Fall Words got a release date!
notes.notes:
Big news, ladies and gentlemen!

Steam approved Fall Words for release and I can finally set a release date.

...🥁🥁🥁...

Fall Words will be released on [b]May 7th[/b]. Hooraaaay! 🎉
